title: Implement Claude API Prompt Caching
description: Implement Claude API prompt caching to reduce token usage and costs. Cache static parts (instructions, data structure docs) and only send fresh data + conversation incrementally. Should reduce costs by ~90% for cached content. Use cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } in system messages.
